newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**
   - **[Biotech]** **Arcus highlights casdatifan kidney cancer profile** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/arcus-casdatifan-trigemx-lilly-metis-astrazeneca/833430/)
     - Updated R&D day data for experimental HIF-2α inhibitor casdatifan in clear cell renal cell carcinoma suggested increased potency compared to Merck's marketed Welireg across multiple settings.
     - Analysts noted potential positioning as an all-line backbone therapy in first-line and subsequent settings.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**
   - **[Biotech]** **Priovant reports Phase 3 uveitis success for brepocitinib** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roivant-brepocitinib-uveitis-study-results/833569/)
     - In the Clarity-1 and Clarity-2 Phase 3 trials, the JAK/TYK2 inhibitor brepocitinib delayed treatment failure in non-infectious uveitis to a median >48 weeks versus 12 weeks for placebo, while eliminating the need for immunosuppressive steroids for 40 weeks.
     - The Roivant subsidiary plans to submit a supplemental NDA for the indication in 1H 2027, adding to its existing dermatomyositis approval (Lisraya).
   - **[Biotech]** **Linafexor-semaglutide combination achieves Phase 2 weight loss** [doi:10.64898/2026.10.18.26365821](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.18.26365821)
     - A 16-week Phase 2 trial of 62 adults with obesity, MASH, and treatment-naive type 2 diabetes evaluated daily oral linafexor (a pulsatile FXR agonist) added to low-dose semaglutide (0.5 mg weekly).
     - The combination more than doubled weight loss compared to semaglutide alone (-6.17% vs. -2.91%; treatment difference, -3.26%; 95% CI, -5.35 to -1.18).
   - **[Biotech]** **Cidara Therapeutics advances ReMEDy2 trial** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2113239677553512704)
     - Enrolled the 200th patient in the Phase 2/3 ReMEDy2 trial of its acute ischemic stroke candidate, with an interim analysis expected in Q1 2027.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**
   - **[Biotech]** **Cognition Therapeutics aligns with FDA on Phase 3 design** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2113209336222687376)
     - Reached alignment with the FDA on the pivotal Phase 3 trial design for zervimesine (CT1812) in dementia with Lewy bodies.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**
   - **[Big Pharma]** **GSK and Ionis secure FDA approval for Hibsago in chronic hepatitis B** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/gsk-ionis-fda-approve-hibsago-chronic-hepatitis-b-bepirovirsen/833541/)
     - The FDA approved bepirovirsen (marketed as Hibsago), a first-in-class antisense oligonucleotide targeting hepatitis B virus, for use alongside standard nucleos(t)ide analogs in non-cirrhotic adults with suppressed viral loads and low active infection proteins.
     - The regimen is administered via periodic injections over six months, with self-administration permitted after the initial dose; pricing details are pending.
   - **[Big Pharma]** **FDA requests removal of major boxed warnings for menopausal hormone therapy** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/consumers/consumer-updates/hormone-replacement-therapies-can-help-women-bothersome-menopausal-menopausal-symptoms)
     - The FDA asked drug manufacturers to update labels by removing cardiovascular disease, breast cancer, and probable dementia risk statements from boxed warnings for MHT/HRT to reflect current risk data.

5. **Business & Strategy**
   - **[Biotech]** **TriGemX inks SPAC transaction** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/arcus-casdatifan-trigemx-lilly-metis-astrazeneca/833430/)
     - TriGemX Bio entered into a merger agreement with a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) to advance its clinical pipeline.
   - **[Biotech]** **Wedgewood Pharmacy recalls compounded veterinary drugs** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/wedgewood-pharmacy-issues-recall-certain-compounded-veterinary-medications-within-expiry-due)
     - Issued a voluntary recall for specific within-expiry compounded veterinary formulations due to analytical testing inconsistencies that could lead to subpotent or superpotent dosing.

6. **Public Health & Policy**
   - **KFF survey shows family health coverage premiums jumped 9% in 2026** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/22/kff-2026-benefits-survey-9-percent-premium-increase/?utm_campaign=rss)
     - Rising healthcare costs forced a 9% average premium increase for family coverage this year, outpacing recent historical trends and squeezing employers and workers.
   - **Telehealth expansion drives off-label GLP-1 prescribing for addiction** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/22/glp-1-drugs-substance-use-disorder-telehealth-off-label-prescription/?utm_campaign=rss)
     - Virtual care platforms are increasingly promoting GLP-1 receptor agonists for substance use disorders prior to formal FDA approvals, raising clinical concerns regarding fragmented patient management and uncharacterized risks.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [Why is Cheese immune to raising Cardiovascular Disease risk?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-yIB9pGJnNI) -- Physionic
        - Analyzes the "dairy matrix" effect to explain why consuming saturated fat via cheese differs in cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk compared to isolated dairy fat.
        - Cites randomized controlled trial data (Feeney et al., 2018) demonstrating differential plasma lipid responses when dairy fat is ingested within the structural cheese matrix.
        - References research (Soerensen et al., 2014) on how dairy calcium in cheese influences fecal fat excretion, blood lipid parameters, and appetite.
        - Highlights findings (Rosqvist et al., 2015) regarding the milk fat globule membrane (MFGM) and its role in modulating plasma lipoproteins, cholesterol metabolism, and gene expression.
    - [Good Doctors Aren’t Afraid to Say “I Don’t Know”](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/yf48ZVeOqT8) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Features Allon Bloch discussing the importance of recognizing uncertainty in clinical decision-making.
        - Argues that sound medical judgment requires physicians to admit when a clinical path forward is unclear rather than resorting to guessing.
        - Frames acknowledging the boundaries of medical knowledge as an essential aspect of patient safety and healthcare practice.
- Pure Science
    - [22 - Beacon #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/V_lCpfPdv7I) -- El Jj
        - Represents entry 22 ("Beacon") in the creator's Mathctober video series.
        - Expresses the creator's ongoing fundamental lack of understanding regarding why a specific mathematical concept or statement holds true.
        - Explains the temporary absence of entries 20 ("Lounge") and 21 ("Hero"), attributing delays to personal priorities affecting independent video production.
